mainEntity.name: How does generative engine optimization differ from traditional SEO for optometrists?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) distinguishes itself from traditional SEO primarily through its use of AI for content creation and optimization. Traditional SEO often involves manual keyword research and content writing, which can be time-consuming and scale-limited. GEO, conversely, leverages AI to rapidly generate vast amounts of highly relevant, optimized content that anticipates patient search queries. While both aim to improve search rankings, GEO offers enhanced efficiency and the ability to cover a broader range of search intent with sophisticated, data-driven content generation, adapting quickly to algorithm changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: GEO uses AI for efficient, large-scale content creation and optimization, whereas traditional SEO relies more on manual processes. Both aim to improve search rankings.
